objective: Wait for Keeper Remulos at the Moonglade to cleanse the Nightmare Engulfed Object.

description: The waters of Lake Elune'ara should dissolve the nightmares engulfing this object. Give me a moment to perform the cleansing, <name>.
completion: Take his ring, <name>. It has served its purpose for Malfurion. It shall now serve a new purpose for you...
